review_text: This wireless mouse is honestly great - smooth tracking, battery lasts forever, and the DPI button placement is perfect for gaming. Only issue is the shape is a bit narrow for my hand, so after an hour of use my wrist starts to hurt. Otherwise no complaints, would recommend to anyone with smaller hands.

pros: good DPI button placement for gaming
cons: wrist pain after an hour of use

scoring_notes.notes: urgency MUST be high - a shape/fit mismatch (narrow mouse body) causes physical pain (wrist hurts). Must not be downgraded to medium just because 'fit' language is present; pain outranks fit. Regression guard for the fit-causes-pain pattern (benchmark case bench-en-013: shape mismatch -> eye pain, still mis-scored medium under v2.2).
